**R&G Station** is a Train Station in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

A part of the long-defunct network of Train Stations, at the southernmost end of the Blue Line. The facility consists of a track-side platform and station building. Situated beneath the Monorail tracks, the location provided ancillary services such as a staffed ticket sales counter and automated ticket machines before the Great War. [1] 

It shares its name with nearby business R & G Processing Services.

R&G Station's main entrance faces north towards State Route 101. A Whitespring Shuttle Bus and a small camper are situated in the parking lot surrounded by Raider logos and detritus. The camper contains a few Caps and the corpse of a Raider propped up in an armchair.

The shuttle bus has a Prospector's Hat, sealed *Charleston Herald*, and a Bubblegum Bear on the seats. To the east of the main building is a small switching station. Inside, one will find a Weapons Workbench as well as a Raider Vendor Bot.

Outside the building on the platform is an Ammunition Vending Machine, Legendary Exchange Machine, Punch Card Machine, and a Medical Supplies Vending Machine. Next to a Radio, there are a few Sleeping Bags, a large Toolbox, and a Baby Carriage containing another Bubblegum Bear.

As of the *Locked & Loaded* update, a Punch Card Machine was added to all Train Stations.

R&G Station appears in *Fallout 76*.
